title: Quanta interactive package player and flow editor boundary
summary: Browser boundary for the Quanta interactive package (.luqu) player and flow editor under static/v3/quanta/: deterministic ZIP64 package verification, state-graph/stream-cue runtime, and draft validation/repack.

carrier.notes: Served under /quanta/ from static/v3/quanta/ (`window.LumeriLuquCore` and `window.LumeriLuquEditorCore`). Boundary contract only; the Quanta v4 .qua player and luqu/ Python package body remain on the Quanta owner's branch until merged.

replaceability.why: The Quanta player and flow editor pages are product shells served alongside the Video editor; only the quanta.tree agent tool is a replaceable Luc capability today.
replaceability.decided: self-Luc spec v0.3 foundation (the editor page shell); docs/luc/self-luc-inventory.md:102

operations.name: LumeriLuquCore.openPackage

input.description: Uint8Array or Blob holding a .luqu ZIP64 package with normative entry order (mimetype, bootstrap.json, manifest.json, ..., index/full.json).

output.description: Verified package handle exposing manifest, bootstrap, fullIndex, indexById, object(id), and readEntryBytes(id).

operations.notes: Verifies ZIP64 container order, canonical JSON, SHA-256 and CRC32 of every indexed entry, capability registry digest, and state/edge/cue references before playback.

operations.name: LumeriLuquEditorCore.validateDraft
operations.notes: Checks entry state existence, state media references, variable types/scopes, transition conditions/actions, stream-cue ranges, reachability, and zero-wait 0us cue loops.

invariants.text: A package whose entry order, canonical JSON, or entry SHA-256/CRC32 disagrees with index/full.json is rejected before playback begins.
Draft edits in the flow editor validate and repack into a deterministic, verified .luqu ZIP64 archive.

break: A package fails container, hash, schema, capability, or reference verification.
A draft contains dangling references, unsupported primitives, or a zero-wait 0us cue loop.

conformance.notes: Covers the in-tree static/v3/quanta/ player and flow editor boundary. The standalone Quanta v4 .qua player and luqu/ Python package body are developed on quanta/player-minimal-20261101 and will be filled in by the Quanta owner upon merge.

known_deviations.text: Only the boundary of Quanta v4 / .luqu present on this branch (static/v3/quanta/*) is contracted here; the Quanta v4 .qua player and luqu/ Python package on branch quanta/player-minimal-20261101 (34ff874f) are owned by the Quanta lane and not merged into this branch.

open_questions.text: When branch quanta/player-minimal-20261101 merges, the Quanta owner should extend iface:editor.quanta-v4/v1 with the .qua player and luqu/ package operations.
